scope: Conditional numeric assessment of one new low-rise model on the declared complete construction site. All generated floors and overhead cover counted; no area deductions, FAR bonuses, rooftop objects, omitted structures or blank-wall/consent exceptions. Existing-site, waterway, overlay, parking/fire and permit reviews remain separate.

rules.title: FAR · counted model floors
rules.interpretation: Count all modeled floors of every modeled building over the whole construction site. Base FAR at most 5. Already-used subdivision aggregation must be absent or fully included. No bonus or deduction is claimed.

rules.title: OSR · uncovered space / counted floors
rules.thai: ไม่น้อยกว่าร้อยละหก
rules.interpretation: Qualifying unroofed construction-site space divided by all counted modeled floor area must be at least 6%. All overhead cover is included in the covered-projection union.

rules.title: Uncovered ground · plot-area minimum
rules.thai: พื้นที่ดินที่ใช้เป็นที่ตั้งอาคาร
rules.interpretation: Residential: at least 30% of construction-site plot area; nonresidential: 10%. Use strict unroofed ground and no unmodeled overhead covers. This denominator differs from MR55 clause 33.

rules.title: Uncovered ground · largest-floor minimum
rules.thai: พื้นที่ชั้นใดชั้นหนึ่งที่มากที่สุดของอาคาร
rules.interpretation: Residential 30% / nonresidential 10% of the largest floor. Evaluate independently of the Bangkok plot-based minimum. The inspected ordinary-building definition does not establish a generic 2 m eaves exception.

rules.title: Permeable planting · allocated model area
rules.thai: ไม่น้อยกว่าร้อยละห้าสิบของพื้นที่ว่าง
rules.interpretation: Allocate at least 50% of qualifying open space to permeable planting. Paving, parking and pools do not automatically qualify. This tests the declared allocation, not a physical landscaping inspection.

rules.title: Boundary openings · floor/height setbacks
rules.clause: MR55 clause 50, printed page 11; BMA 2544 clause 54, printed page 16
rules.thai: ผนังของอาคารที่มีหน้าต่าง ประตู ช่องระบายอากาศหรือช่องแสง
rules.interpretation: Treat all faces as having openings. Enforce 2 m up to whole-building height 9 m, 3 m above 9 m and below 23 m, and the stricter Bangkok third-floor tier. No blank-wall, boundary-building or neighbor-consent exception.

rules.title: All-around open space
rules.thai: ที่ว่างโดยรอบอาคาร
rules.interpretation: Whole-building height up to 15 m: at least 1 m around the building; above 15 m: at least 2 m. All modeled building extents are included; no small-house exception is claimed.

rules.title: Public-road setback
rules.clause: MR55 clause 41, printed page 9; BMA 2544 clause 50, printed page 15
rules.thai: กึ่งกลางถนนสาธารณะ
rules.interpretation: For specified uses / over 2 floors / over 8 m, and large buildings under BMA clause 50: ROW under 10 m requires 6 m from centreline; 10–20 m requires ROW/10 from the near boundary; over 20 m requires 2 m. No residential exception is granted. Smaller ordinary buildings on ROW under 6 m use 3 m from centreline. Conversion requires a straight uniform public ROW whose near boundary coincides with the selected plot edge. The generator uses a conservative plot-derived area bound before candidate area is known.

rules.title: Public-road height plane
rules.clause: MR55 clause 44, printed page 9; BMA 2544 clause 49, printed page 14
rules.thai: เขตด้านตรงข้ามของถนนสาธารณะ
rules.interpretation: Every building point must satisfy H <= 2(s + ROW). Require compatible road/site height datum and straight uniform ROW with parallel opposite boundary. Intersect every declared frontage conservatively; do not grant wider-road/corner or rooftop-object exceptions.

rules.title: Y.7 use and size condition
rules.thai: การอยู่อาศัยประเภทอาคารอยู่อาศัยรวม
rules.interpretation: Condominium modeled total below 10,000 m² stays below the collective-housing size condition. Office operation area is distinct from working-room/lettable area and includes related outdoor activity. Over 1,000 and at most 10,000 m² requires a qualifying access exception; this core model only supports the declared >=16 m public-ROW route, not an unverified station-distance exception.
